name: Mikasa Yasuyuki
source:
A Japanese relative of Arnold's grandmother. Although it seems as though he doesn't like Arnold personally, Yasuyuki is actually not very sociable. In a case of an accident, Yasuyuki shows calm judgment and a keen ability to offer help. He is fond of animals (especially cats).
